people.name: Asia
people.line: A Roman province in western Asia Minor.

people.name: Hermogenes
people.line: A believer who deserted Paul in Asia.

people.name: Phygelus
people.line: Believer who deserted Paul in Asia

translations.web: This you know, that all who are in Asia turned away from me, of whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.
translations.bsb: You know that everyone in the Province of Asia has deserted me, including Phygelus and Hermogenes.
translations.kjv: This thou knowest, that all they which are in Asia be turned away from me; of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes.
translations.asv: This thou knowest, that all that are in Asia turned away from me; of whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.
